## Highlights

Harness UI 0.10 adopts Harness's execution-only Environment API. Built-in Full Control and Sandbox profiles use Host-owned preparation and Run-local execution cleanup; custom integrations must follow the same boundary.

## Upgrade notes

### Minimum versions

- Python **3.13 or later** remains required.
- Both `a13n-harness` and `a13n-stream-protocol` require **`>=0.10.0,<0.11.0`**. Harness UI 0.10 cannot run against the 0.9 library line.
- `a13n-envd-client` requires **`>=0.1.2,<0.2.0`**; `a13n-logging` remains **`>=0.2.0,<0.3.0`**.
- Managed Sandbox acquisition selects the daemon version matching the installed Envd client, not the latest daemon. Explicit local executables must also match that client release exactly. Full Control does not require managed daemon acquisition.

### Custom Environment integrations

This release breaks the former combined management/execution API; no compatibility adapter is supplied. Built-in integrations are migrated with the application. Custom `EnvironmentProjectAdapter.bind()` implementations must prepare the Host-selected target and return an inert `EnvironmentConnector`, rather than a combined lifecycle adapter. Preserve any observed binding state through the Host's publication path, including preparation failures and cancellation.

Environment Provider plugins use **`ProviderManifest(api_version=1)`** and the execution-only definition. Rebuild them and declare **`a13n-harness>=0.10.0,<0.11.0`**. A plugin alone still does not authorize a Project profile; the Host must select it and an appropriate Project adapter.

Ordinary Harness middleware configuration retains `schema_version="1"`; it is separate from the Provider manifest API. Only middleware using the changed Environment APIs requires that source migration.

### Local data

Back up the configuration and data directories before upgrading, and stop the older process before opening them with 0.10. Database upgrades remain **forward-only**; do not run an older UI against an upgraded database.
